meta.title: Lingo - In-Game Chat AI Translator
meta.description: Lingo helps translate the message you are about to send in game chat into clearer Chinese, English, or Russian while keeping game context intact.
meta.keywords: in-game chat AI translator, AI game translator, game chat translation, multiplayer chat translator, team message translator, Dota 2 translator, League of Legends translator, World of Warcraft translator, Overwatch 2 translator

hero.title:
In-Game Chat
AI Translator
hero.subtitle: Translate the team message you are about to send into natural Chinese, English, or Russian, with game terms and chat tone kept ready for your final review.
hero.supportLine: Built for multiplayer games where text chat matters.

mockup.title: Translate, review, send
mockup.body: Turns retreat, group, smoke, and cooldown calls into natural chat-ready messages.
mockup.source: Don't force yet. Wait for my BKB.
mockup.result: Hold. Wait for my BKB, then we fight.
mockup.chatDraft: Hold. Wait for my BKB, then we fight.

features.title: Make the message clear before it leaves.
features.subtitle: Lingo focuses on your outgoing game chat: understand the context, translate the line, and leave final send control to you.

instant.title: Instant translation
instant.description: Type what you mean and get a chat-ready line without rewriting it again and again.

server.title: Game context
server.description: Keeps the intent of calls like BKB, smoke, focus, and regroup.

phrases.title: Sharper short lines
phrases.description: Retreat, group, wait, and engage calls become cleaner for fast team chat.

languages.title: Chinese, English, Russian
languages.description: Useful for mixed-language squads when you want your own message to land clearly.

supportedGames.title: Built for multiplayer games with text chat.
supportedGames.subtitle: It is not locked to one title. Use it when you need to send your own chat message to teammates who speak another language.
supportedGames.note: Use it as a translation helper before you send text chat in multiplayer games.

dota2.name: Dota 2
dota2.description: Smoke, BKB, retreat, and fight calls become easier to send as short team messages.

lol.name: League of Legends
lol.description: Lane, jungle, objective, and focus calls can be phrased more naturally.

wow.name: World of Warcraft
wow.description: Clean up raid, party, and regroup messages before sending them to the group.

ow2.name: Overwatch 2
ow2.description: Position, focus, regroup, and push calls stay short enough for quick chat.

howItWorks.title: Three steps before you send.
howItWorks.subtitle: Type the original line, generate the translation, then send the result in chat.

select.title: Type your line
select.description: Write the message you want to send to teammates in Chinese, English, or Russian.

translate.title: Generate the translation
translate.description: Lingo translates and cleans up the phrasing so it feels natural in game chat.

paste.title: Review and send
paste.description: Put the result into the chat box, review it, and send it yourself.

download.title: Download Lingo for your next match.
download.subtitle: Official installers are delivered through our Tencent Cloud mirror for Windows and macOS.

footer.tagline: Translate the game chat message you are about to send into clearer team communication.
